title: Member Images: Importing Members with Profile Photos, Logos & Cover Photos | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Member Images: Importing Members with Profile Photos, Logos & Cover Photos Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046959 Importing members requires clean, unformatted text data (no line breaks or styling) mapping to the proper columns to ensure a successful upload. How To Import Members Via CSV File This includes the links for the images that will be uploaded with the file. Add Image URL to Import File Insert the URL for the image into the corresponding field: logo profile_photo cover_photo Currently, the import tool supports the following image formats: webp jpg / jpeg png gif Cover Photo The Profile Cover Photo add-on must be active on the website for imported cover photos to display on member profiles. Hosting Images These images can be uploaded to the Media Manager in order to guarantee a successful upload. Once the images are uploaded to the Media Manager, their URL can be grabbed by clicking on the Copy URL option: The images can also be hosted on external platforms, however, t his tool is meant to help in migrating a site from one platform to another, not to copy images from a 3rd party source without their consent. For in-depth information about the Media Manager check out this link: >> Media Manager Folder Importing Member Images Please follow these steps to import all of the images to the members that were just imported: Navigate to the Members >> Member Images: ** Important Note: This tab will only display if the system identifies recently imported images through the member import template. ** Choose an appropriate number of members to import the images of at a time in the dropdown below: Click on " Update Results ": Use the Bulk Actions checkbox to select all of the members on the page, then select Fetch from Source and Resize Photos from the dropdown menu. If prompted, check the Select All option to include all remaining records. Click the " Apply Action " button. There will be a notification that the images are being processed: Do not close the window or navigate away from the page during this process. Repeat the steps above for each page until all images have been fetched and resized. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
